\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{pmmeta}
\pmcanonicalname{TimeInvariant}
\pmtitle{time invariant}
\pmtype{Definition}
\pmclassification{msc}{00A05}
\pmdefines{time-invariant}
\endmetadata
\begin{document}
A dynamical system is {\bf time-invariant} if its generating formula is dependent on state only, and independent of time. A synonym for time-invariant is autonomous.
\end{document}
